messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout STARTED for model catalog entry `open-phi-3.2` -> serving variant `open-phi-3.2-q8`. Traffic split: 5% canary, 95% baseline. Fallback ordering: open-phi-3.1, open-phi-3.0. Change window: 2h. Canary ID: canary-20260320-42
shaun: ack. I'll own SLO watch and hold on any automated scale changes. tagging @anya @mike for pin/eviction concerns. :eyes:
anya: quick check — did we pin the low-memory variant on burst hosts? I want to avoid evictions on t4 pool.
mike: yes, pinned `open-phi-3.2-q8` -> `pinlist: t4-lowmem` in the rollout config. snippet:```json
{"model":"open-phi-3.2","variant":"q8","pinlist":["t4-lowmem"],"canary_pct":5}```
lina: perf note: initial p95 looks +12ms on short prompts in staging. not alarming but watch p95 and token throughput. I'll run a small rerun of the eval set.
shaun: rolling metric checks in progress: p50,p95,errors,token-cost. thresholds: p95 < 220ms, error_rate < 0.5%, cost delta < 8%. If any threshold trips, we rollback to baseline and raise incident.
infra-bot: autoscaler notice: t4 pool remaining capacity at 92%. no autoscale event.
mike: added a soft-fallback policy so that if model variant exhausts kv-cache memory it immediately fails over to `open-phi-3.1-q8` instead of queuing. config: `fallback.on_oom = immediate`
anya: safety gate: quality regression hooks enabled — sampling 100 requests per minute to offline-eval. If eval fail rate > 3% for 15m, automatic rollback flag will be set.
shaun: good. manual rollback plan ready: `gcloud deploy rollback canary-20260320-42` + notify infra and support. We won't do automated rollback without a human ack unless the error_rate > 5%.
lina: observing a small spike in memory GC on 2 hosts at t+18m — investigating, might be noisy.
mike: grabbed logs from those hosts: ```
2026-03-20T15:05:12Z host-42 kernel: oom_killer invoked? No, just GC
2026-03-20T15:05:25Z runtime: kv-cache miss + reallocate 80MB
```
shaun: thanks. keep me posted. If this reaches 3 hosts or p95 > 250ms, we stop the canary and pin baseline.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-20260320-42 metrics snapshot: p95 210ms (baseline 198ms), error_rate 0.3%, eval_fail_rate 0.8%. current canary_pct 5%. Next check in 10m.
anya: looks within guardrails. continuing watch.
infra-bot: alert: one host reclaimed from t4-lowmem pool due to preemptible eviction (host-87). adjusted pinlist fallback to route around host-87.
mike: updated routing rule: exclude host-87, redistributed canary to another t4.
shaun: after 45m, metrics stable. increasing canary to 20% per rollout plan. shaun ran `deploy-bot: scale_canary canary-20260320-42 -> 20%`
deploy-bot: Canary update: canary_pct=20%. scheduled checks every 10m.
lina: running long prompt tests now — no regen issues so far.
shaun: moving to monitor-only. if nothing breaks in next 60m we proceed to full enable and add pin for q8 across catalog. notify product for release notes.
anya: creating a short release note: "Open-Phi 3.2 enabled as canary; q8 quantized variant; ordered fallbacks: 3.1, 3.0; quality gates active." will drop in release channel when fully enabled.
mike: FYI saved rollback command in runbook and pinned the variant list to prevent accidental eviction during scale ops.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-20260320-42 status at t+90m: p95 205ms, error_rate 0.4%, eval_fail_rate 0.9%. No automatic rollback triggered.
shaun: proceeding to full rollout in staged increments. final note: keep the fallback priority as configured; do not reorder without eng-releases approval. :lock:
anya: thanks all — will follow up with post-rollout perf notes and the release blurb.
